gravity.description: Scales gravity on the candy and ropes (soap bubbles' lift scales with it, so bubbles still float). 2 = the candy falls twice as far in the same time and swings about 1.4x faster, so cuts must be timed more tightly; 0.5 = slow, floaty motion with more time to react. Air-cushion puffs keep their strength, so they push relatively harder at low gravity. Applies at once, in the level in play.

ropeElasticity.description: How much ropes stretch and bounce. 1 = as shipped (a hanging candy stretches its rope under 1%); each +0.25 halves the rope solver's passes: 1.5 stretches about 3% at rest and 12% when the candy drops onto the rope, 2 about 10% and 34%. Stretchy ropes let the candy sag and bounce, so swings are harder to predict. Applies at once, in the level in play.
